name: SQUAD XXX: Slut Hunt 🚨
source:
The city's falling apart — cyber-mutants on the streets, implants messing with minds, and pleasure-driven chaos spreading like a virus. You're the commander of a special ops team tasked with keeping order, capturing key suspects, and uncovering who's really pulling the strings behind the mutation outbreak.

Send operatives on missions, balance skills and stress, upgrade your team, run research, and handle detainees to extract info. Track down the truth behind Divinexus — a mysterious corporation turning people into hybrid creatures linked to the strange AI-entity C.O.R.E. 

And yeah... desire can be just as dangerous as corruption. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4144180/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这座城市正在分崩离析——街道上出现了网络变种人，植入物扰乱了思想，快乐驱动的混乱像病毒一样蔓延。你是一支特别行动小组的指挥官，负责维持秩序、抓捕关键嫌疑人，并查明谁是突变爆发的幕后黑手。

派遣特工执行任务，平衡技能和压力，升级你的团队，进行研究，并处理被拘留者以提取信息。追查Divinexus背后的真相——一家神秘公司，将人变成与奇怪的人工智能实体C.O.R.E有关的混合生物。

是的……欲望和腐败一样危险。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4144180/]Steam[/url]]
